_note: The decoration lights' templates and strings for tools/christmas_season_20261116.py (the owner, 2026-11-16). A template is how bulbs look (lighttemplates); a string is where they hang (lightstrings: on an NPC by name in its own frame at size 1, or in a world). Shapes: spiral, rings, line, box, points (database/decorlights.go). Only the tree's for now; a fence would be {"template": "Christmas lights", "npc": "", "world": 0, "shape": "line", "params": {"from": [x,y,z], "to": [x,y,z], "sag": 0.3, "posts": 4}}, a building's roof {"shape": "box", "params": {"min": [...], "max": [...], "edges": "top"}}.
